Maya: Morning team — quick async update (short):
Maya: What I did: validated AMS spot fallback, drained a dev node, trimmed queued batch sizes for the long-tail requests.
Maya: Blockers: ams-west quota bump still pending with cloud support (ticket #123456).
Maya: Today: need a small quota request for eu-west canary (4 GPUs) + a quick sanity run of eviction policy.
Kyle: ack. I can kick off the quota request now, @Priya can you confirm preferred instance families/AZs?
Priya: Prefer g5.2xlarge if available, spread across eu-west-1a/b. If not, fallback to g5.xlarge in the same AZs. ETA ~2hrs to confirm with the account team.
Jonah: FYI saw elevated prewarm failures overnight on tilt cluster — runtime OOM on long sequences. Snippet below from logs: 
Jonah: ```
runtime: oom when allocating 1.2G for KV cache
service: tilt-infer-03
model: rdx-13b-v1 quantized
stack: /srv/infer/runtime/allocator.cpp:273
```
Maya: thanks Jonah — please create a short issue with the stack, sample prompt that repros, and the model config (batch size/seq len).
Jonah: done: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789 — added logs and sample prompt.
infra-bot: Auto-note: quota request Q-948 submitted to cloud accounts team for eu-west-1 (4x g5.2xlarge).
Kyle: small ask — can we enable burst capacity on the dedicated pool for tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC for the canary? Will be limited to test namespace only. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya: +1 as long as we gate it to the test namespace and set a temporary rate cap (200 rps) and CPU OOM guard.
Maya: agreed. Add rollback conditions: 95th pct latency > baseline + 500ms OR error rate > 1% for 5m.
Kyle: will update the runbook and open the change PR now — tagging @Priya @Jonah for review.
Priya: Reviewing the PR, small nit on the autoscale step-down window.
Jonah: LGTM otherwise, added a note about KV cache sizing in the runbook.
Maya: Awesome. If nobody objects I'll close this thread EOD and follow up on the quota + PR. :white_check_mark:
Kyle: +1 :thumbsup:
Priya: +1
infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled capacity snapshot will run in 30m for eu-west-1.
